parsed.name: 安捷伦 DSO7054 数字存储示波器
parsed.description: 一款台式数字存储示波器，用于观察、触发、采集和测量电压随时间变化的波形，常用于电子电路、射频系统和实验装置中的信号调试与时域分析。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop digital storage oscilloscope used to view, trigger on, acquire, and measure voltage waveforms over time. It is commonly used for signal debugging and time-domain analysis in electronics, RF systems, and laboratory experiments.
